description: Compare one U.S. household's monthly electricity use and price with similar homes (same state climate, home size, household size, and month). Returns the usage percentile, the typical kWh range, the rate vs. the state or utility average, the dollar gap to a typical home, the estimated share going to air conditioning or heating that month, and likely causes. Data: U.S. EIA monthly retail sales, EIA Form 861, and the EIA Residential Energy Consumption Survey (RECS). Statistical comparison, not a bill audit.

amount_due.description: Total amount on the bill in USD. Optional; enables the rate comparison.

home_size_sqft.description: Home size in square feet, e.g. 1800.

household_size.description: Number of people living in the home.

kwh.description: kWh used on this bill (one month).

month.description: Month the bill covers (1-12). Optional but recommended: use varies a lot by season.

state.description: U.S. state or D.C.: two-letter code (TX) or name (Texas).

utility.description: Electric utility or retail provider name. Optional; compares the rate with that utility's average.

title: Check if an electric bill is normal
